title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer m.
Line 2: m space-separated integers sorted ascending (empty line when m == 0).
Line 3: integer n.
Line 4: n space-separated integers sorted ascending (empty line when n == 0).
outputFormat: The median of the two arrays combined, printed with exactly 5 digits after the decimal point.
constraints:
0 <= m, n <= 1000
1 <= m + n
-10^6 <= values <= 10^6
Both arrays are sorted ascending.

examples.explanation: The merged array is [1, 2, 3] and its median is 2.
The merged array is [1, 2, 3, 4]; the median is (2 + 3) / 2.
